books.name: Adam Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Adam Alaihis Salam ki kahani paidaish ke bajaye Allah ki taraf se unki takhleeq se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Mitti se takhleeq
pages.roman:
Insaan ki ibtida Allah ki takhleeq se hui. Allah ne Adam Alaihis Salam ko mitti se paida kiya. Quran is takhleeq ko Allah ki qudrat ki nishani ke taur par bayan karta hai.

Adam Alaihis Salam ki kahani aam insani paidaish se shuru nahi hoti. Unhein Allah ne paida kiya, aur unki zindagi ke aage ke waqiat mein ilm, zimmedari aur hidayat ki ahmiyat samne aati hai.
pages.english:
Human life begins with Allah’s creation. Allah created Adam Alaihis Salam from dust; the Quran presents this as a sign of His power.

This is not an account of an ordinary human birth. The events that follow introduce knowledge, responsibility and guidance.
pages.noteRoman: Is ki tareekh ya jagah ki apni taraf se tafseel nahi jori gayi.

pages.title: Zameen par zimmedari
pages.roman: Allah ne farishton ko zameen mein ek khalifah banane ki khabar di. Farishton ne sawal kiya; Allah ne farmaya ke woh jaanta hai jo woh nahi jaante.
pages.english: Allah told the angels that He would place a successor on earth. He knew what they did not know.

pages.title: Ilm ki nemat
pages.roman:
Zameen mein khalifah ke zikr ke saath Quran Adam Alaihis Salam ko diye gaye ilm ka waqia sunata hai. Allah ne unhein naam sikhaye aur phir un cheezon ko farishton ke samne pesh kiya.

Farishton ne apne ilm ki had tasleem ki: unke paas wahi ilm tha jo Allah ne unhein sikhaya tha. Adam Alaihis Salam ne Allah ke sikhaye hue naam bataye. Yeh ilm unki apni quwwat ka dawa nahi, unke Rabb ki ata thi.
pages.english:
Alongside the account of responsibility on earth, the Quran describes the knowledge Allah gave Adam Alaihis Salam. Allah taught him the names and presented the things to the angels.

The angels acknowledged that they knew only what Allah had taught them. Adam Alaihis Salam then told them the names. His knowledge was a gift from his Lord.

pages.title: Iblis ka takabbur
pages.roman:
Lekin takabbur ka rawaiya bhi isi waqie mein samne aata hai. Farishton ko Adam Alaihis Salam ke samne sajde ka hukm diya gaya.

Iblis ne inkar kiya aur takabbur dikhaya. Us ne apni paidaish ka muqabla karke khud ko behtar samjha.
pages.english: The angels were commanded to prostrate before Adam Alaihis Salam. Iblis refused out of arrogance and claimed superiority.

pages.title: Jannat aur mana kiya gaya darakht
pages.roman:
Adam Alaihis Salam aur unki biwi ko Jannat mein rehne ki ijazat mili. Wahan unhein khane ki farakhi di gayi, lekin ek darakht ke qareeb jane se mana kiya gaya.

Is ijazat ke saath ek wazeh had bhi thi. Aage ka waqia isi hukm aur Shaitan ke behkane se jurta hai. Quran darakht ki qisam nahi batata; isliye yahan uska koi naam muqarrar nahi kiya gaya.
pages.english:
Adam Alaihis Salam and his wife were permitted to live and eat freely in Paradise, with one clear restriction: they were not to approach a particular tree.

The next episode concerns that command and the temptation of Satan. The Quran does not identify the kind of tree, so no name is added here.

pages.title: Waswasa aur apni ghalati ka iqrar
pages.roman:
Shaitan ne Adam Alaihis Salam aur unki biwi ko behkaya. Unhon ne us darakht se kha liya jiske qareeb jane se mana kiya gaya tha. Phir un par apni halat zahir hui aur woh Jannat ke patton se apne aap ko dhakne lage.

Apne Rabb ke samne unhon ne apni ghalati ka iqrar kiya aur maghfirat aur rahmat mangi. Kahani yahan sirf ghalati par nahi rukti: iske saath taubah ki qubooliyat ka waqia bhi aata hai.
pages.english:
Satan tempted Adam Alaihis Salam and his wife, and they ate from the forbidden tree. Their nakedness became apparent to them, and they began covering themselves with leaves from Paradise.

Before their Lord they acknowledged their wrongdoing and asked for forgiveness and mercy. The account continues beyond the mistake to the acceptance of repentance.

pages.title: Taubah aur zameen par hidayat
pages.roman: Ghalati ke iqrar ke saath taubah ka darwaza bhi khula. Allah ne Adam Alaihis Salam ko taubah ke alfaaz sikhaye aur unki taubah qubool ki. Zameen par rehne ke saath Allah ki hidayat ki pairwi ka rasta bataya gaya.
pages.english: Allah accepted Adam Alaihis Salam’s repentance. Life on earth would be accompanied by guidance from Him, which people were to follow.

pages.title: Do beton ki qurbani
pages.roman:
Quran Adam Alaihis Salam ke do beton ka waqia bhi sunata hai.

Donon ne qurbani pesh ki; ek ki qubool hui aur doosre ki nahi. Jawab mein Allah ke haan taqwa ki ahmiyat batayi gayi. In ayaat mein beton ke naam nahi diye gaye.
pages.english: The Quran relates that Adam Alaihis Salam’s two sons offered sacrifices. One was accepted and the other was not. Acceptance is linked to mindfulness of Allah; the sons are not named in these verses.

pages.title: Na-haq qatl ka zulm
pages.roman:
Qurbani ke is waqie mein bhaiyon ka rawaiya mukhtalif tha. Ek bhai ne doosre ko qatl ki dhamki di.

Doosre ne Allah ka khauf zahir kiya. Phir uske bhai ne use qatl kar diya aur nuqsan uthane walon mein ho gaya.
pages.english: One brother threatened to kill the other, who expressed fear of Allah. His brother then killed him and became one of the losers.

pages.title: Zameen aur dafan ki seekh
pages.roman: Qatl ke baad ek aur manzar samne aaya. Allah ne ek kawwa bheja jo zameen khod raha tha, taake qatil ko apne bhai ki mayyat chhupane ka tareeqa samajh aaye. Use apni bebasi par afsos hua.
pages.english: Allah sent a crow scratching the ground to show the killer how to cover his brother’s body. He recognized his helplessness and became regretful.

books.birthNoteEnglish: Adam Alaihis Salam’s account begins with his creation by Allah, rather than a human birth.
books.teaser: Insani kahani Adam Alaihis Salam ki takhleeq se shuru hoti hai.
books.openingRoman: Insani kahani Adam Alaihis Salam ki takhleeq se shuru hoti hai. Ilm ki nemat, Iblis ka takabbur aur taubah ki qubooliyat—yeh waqiat batate hain ke Allah ki hidayat insaan ki zindagi mein kitni aham hai.
books.openingEnglish: The human story begins with the creation of Adam Alaihis Salam. The gift of knowledge, the arrogance of Iblis and the acceptance of repentance introduce the need for Allah’s guidance.

books.name: Idris Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Sachche Nabi
pages.roman: Quran Idris Alaihis Salam ko sachcha aur Nabi kehta hai. Unki paidaish, peshe ya safaron ki tafseel in ayaat mein nahi di gayi.
pages.english: The Quran describes Idris Alaihis Salam as a man of truth and a prophet. These verses do not narrate his birth, occupation or journeys.

pages.title: Buland maqam aur sabr
pages.roman: Allah ne Idris Alaihis Salam ko buland maqam ata kiya. Quran unhein sabr karne walon mein shamil karta hai aur Allah ki rahmat mein dakhil hone ka zikr karta hai.
pages.english: Allah raised Idris Alaihis Salam to a high station. He is also named among the patient and those admitted into Allah’s mercy.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Idris Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ka lamba safarnama Quran mein nahi aata.
books.openingRoman: Idris Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ka lamba safarnama Quran mein nahi aata. Jo pehchan milti hai, woh bahut qeemti hai: sachchai, nabuwat, sabr aur Allah ki taraf se buland maqam.
books.openingEnglish: The Quran does not give a long biography of Idris Alaihis Salam. It preserves his truthfulness, prophethood, patience and the high station Allah granted him.

books.name: Nuh Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Apni qaum ki taraf paigham
pages.roman: Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko Allah ki ibadat aur uske taqwa ki dawat di. Unhon ne apne paigham par dunyawi maal ka badla nahi manga.
pages.english: Nuh Alaihis Salam called his people to worship Allah and be mindful of Him. He did not ask them for wealth in return.

pages.title: Din aur raat dawat
pages.roman: Dawat sirf ek martaba ka paigham nahi thi. Nuh Alaihis Salam ne din aur raat, khule taur par aur alag se, apni qaum ko samjhaya. Unhon ne Allah se maghfirat mangne ki dawat di, lekin log inkar par jamay rahe.
pages.english: Nuh Alaihis Salam called his people by night and day, publicly and privately. He urged them to seek forgiveness, but many persisted in refusal.

pages.title: Lambi muddat
pages.roman: Yeh koshish ek lambi muddat par phaili hui thi. Quran kehta hai ke Nuh Alaihis Salam apni qaum mein pachaas kam ek hazaar saal rahe. Yeh unki dawat ki lambi muddat ka zikr hai; ise unki poori umar ka yaqini hisab nahi banaya gaya.
pages.english: The Quran says Nuh Alaihis Salam remained among his people for a thousand years less fifty. This is not presented here as a complete calculation of his lifespan.

pages.title: Kashti banane ka hukm
pages.roman:
Lambi dawat ke bawajood qaum ke inkar ka silsila jari raha. Allah ne Nuh Alaihis Salam ko apni nigrani aur wahi ke mutabiq kashti banane ka hukm diya.

Nuh Alaihis Salam kashti bana rahe the aur qaum ke sardaar guzarte hue mazaq urate the. Isi kashti ke saath aage iman walon ki nijat ka waqia jura hai.
pages.english:
Despite the long call, the people continued to reject the message. Allah instructed Nuh Alaihis Salam to build the ark under His care and revelation.

As he built, leaders of his people passed by and mocked him. This same ark would become part of the account of the believers’ rescue.

pages.title: Toofan aur sawari
pages.roman: Phir Allah ka hukm aane ka waqt hua. Jab Allah ka hukm aaya, Nuh Alaihis Salam ko iman walon aur hukm ke mutabiq joron ko kashti mein lene ko kaha gaya. Iman lane wale kam the.
pages.english: When Allah’s command came, Nuh Alaihis Salam took the believers and the commanded pairs aboard. Only a few had believed.

pages.title: Beta aur pahad
pages.roman:
Kashti lehron ke darmiyan chal rahi thi. Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apne bete ko pukara ke woh unke saath sawar ho jaye aur inkar karne walon ke saath na rahe.

Bete ne pahad par panah lene ka khayal zahir kiya. Nuh Alaihis Salam ne bataya ke Allah ke faisle se uski rahmat ke siwa koi bachane wala nahi. Phir donon ke darmiyan lehar aa gayi aur beta doobne walon mein ho gaya.
pages.english:
The ark was moving among the waves. Nuh Alaihis Salam called to his son to board with them rather than remain with the disbelievers.

His son thought a mountain would shelter him. Nuh Alaihis Salam explained that no one could protect against Allah’s decree except through His mercy. A wave separated them, and the son was among those drowned.

pages.title: Pani utar gaya
pages.roman:
Toofan ka anjaam bhi Allah ke hukm se hua. Allah ke hukm se zameen ne pani nigal liya aur aasman tham gaya.

Kashti Judi par thehar gayi. Nuh Alaihis Salam ko salamati aur barkaton ke saath utarne ko kaha gaya.
pages.english: At Allah’s command, the waters receded and the ark rested on Judi. Nuh Alaihis Salam was told to disembark in peace and blessing.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Ek Nabi apni qaum ko baar-baar Allah ki taraf bulate rahe.
books.openingRoman: Ek Nabi apni qaum ko baar-baar Allah ki taraf bulate rahe. Nuh Alaihis Salam ki kahani lambi dawat se kashti aur toofan tak pahunchti hai—jahan nijat ka faisla quwwat ya rishtedari se nahi hua.
books.openingEnglish: Nuh Alaihis Salam repeatedly called his people to Allah. His story moves from a long mission to the ark and the flood, when strength and family ties could not secure safety.

books.name: Hud Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Aad ki taraf dawat
pages.roman: Hud Alaihis Salam Aad ki taraf bheje gaye. Unhon ne qaum ko sirf Allah ki ibadat ki dawat di aur apne liye koi ujrat nahi mangi.
pages.english: Hud Alaihis Salam was sent to Aad. He called them to worship Allah alone and asked no payment for his message.

pages.title: Quwwat par ghuroor
pages.roman:
Magar qaum ko apni quwwat par ghuroor tha. Aad ko quwwat aur imkanat mile the.

Hud Alaihis Salam ne unhein Allah ki nematein yaad dilayin aur takabbur se roka. Qaum ne apni taqat par ghuroor kiya.
pages.english: Aad had strength and resources. Hud Alaihis Salam reminded them of Allah’s gifts, while they arrogantly boasted of their power.

pages.title: Badal aur tez hawa
pages.roman:
Phir woh manzar aaya jise qaum ne barish ki umeed samjha. Unhon ne badal dekha to use barish lane wala samjha.

Woh azab wali hawa thi. Quran us tez hawa ka zikr karta hai jo un par musallat hui.
pages.english: They saw a cloud and expected rain, but it brought the wind of punishment. The Quran describes a fiercely destructive wind.

pages.title: Iman walon ki nijat
pages.roman: Is anjaam mein iman walon ki nijat ka zikr bhi hai. Allah ne Hud Alaihis Salam aur unke saath iman lane walon ko apni rahmat se bacha liya. Qaum ki quwwat Allah ke faisle ko rok na saki.
pages.english: Allah saved Hud Alaihis Salam and the believers with him through His mercy. Their people’s worldly strength could not prevent His judgment.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Aad ko apni taqat par naaz tha.
books.openingRoman: Aad ko apni taqat par naaz tha. Hud Alaihis Salam ne unhein unke Rabb ki yaad dilayi. Is kahani mein quwwat ke ghuroor aur Allah par iman ka anjaam samne aata hai.
books.openingEnglish: The people of Aad were proud of their strength. Hud Alaihis Salam reminded them of their Lord. Their story contrasts pride in power with faith in Allah.

books.name: Salih Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Thamud aur pahari ghar
pages.roman: Salih Alaihis Salam ne Thamud ko Allah ki ibadat ki dawat di. Unki qaum paharon mein ghar tarashti thi. Quran is hunar ke saath unki zimmedari bhi yaad dilata hai.
pages.english: Salih Alaihis Salam called Thamud to worship Allah. His people carved homes into mountains, but their skill did not remove their responsibility to Him.

pages.title: Allah ki nishani
pages.roman:
Isi qaum ke samne Allah ki ek nishani pesh hui. Qaum ke liye oontni ek nishani thi.

Salih Alaihis Salam ne usko nuqsan na pahunchane ko kaha. Pani ke liye uska aur qaum ka muqarrar hissa tha.
pages.english: A she-camel was a sign for the people. Salih Alaihis Salam warned them not to harm her, and water was to be shared on appointed turns.

pages.title: Hukm ki khilaf warzi
pages.roman: Lekin qaum ne is tanbeeh ka lihaz na kiya. Qaum ne oontni ko maar diya aur apne Rabb ke hukm se sarkashi ki. Salih Alaihis Salam ne unhein teen din ki mohlat ki khabar di.
pages.english: The people killed the she-camel and defied their Lord’s command. Salih Alaihis Salam announced a respite of three days. No animal is illustrated.
pages.noteRoman: Is waqia ki jaanwar wali tasveer nahi banayi gayi.

pages.title: Nijat aur anjaam
pages.roman: Phir Allah ke faisle ka waqt aaya. Allah ne Salih Alaihis Salam aur iman walon ko bachaya. Zulm karne walon ko saikha ne aa liya aur unke ghar unhein na bacha sake.
pages.english: Allah saved Salih Alaihis Salam and the believers. Those who did wrong were overtaken by the blast; their homes could not protect them.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Paharon mein tarashe hue ghar Thamud ke hunar ki nishani the.
books.openingRoman: Paharon mein tarashe hue ghar Thamud ke hunar ki nishani the. Salih Alaihis Salam ne unhein Allah ki ibadat ki taraf bulaya; phir oontni ki nishani unke liye ita-at ki azmaish bani.
books.openingEnglish: The rock-carved homes of Thamud displayed their skill. Salih Alaihis Salam called them to worship Allah, and the she-camel became a sign and a test of obedience.

books.name: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Rushd aur haq ki taraf rujoo
pages.roman: Jab log apne aqeede par chale aa rahe the, Ibrahim Alaihis Salam haq ki taraf mutawajjah the. Allah ne unhein rushd ata kiya tha. Unki kahani ka markaz yahi pehchan hai: ibadat sirf us Rabb ki jo sab ka paida karne wala hai.
pages.english: Allah granted Ibrahim Alaihis Salam sound judgment. This account begins with his scripturally established call, without adding an unreported birth date or childhood legend.

pages.title: Walid ko narmi se samjhana
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki dawat apne walid tak bhi pahunchi. Unhon ne adab aur narmi se aisi cheezon ki ibadat par sawal kiya jo na sun sakti thin, na dekh sakti thin aur na madad kar sakti thin.

Woh apne walid ko hidayat ki taraf bula rahe the. Haq ki baat kehne ke saath unke andaaz mein narmi bhi thi.
pages.english: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam respectfully questioned his father about worshipping what could neither hear nor see, and invited him to guidance.

pages.title: Sitara, chand aur suraj
pages.roman:
Qaumi aqeede par sawal sirf buton tak mehdood nahi tha. Sitara, chand aur suraj—sab dhal jate hain.

Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne isi baat ko apni qaum ke samne daleel banaya. Unhon ne apna rukh us zaat ki taraf kiya jis ne aasman aur zameen ko paida kiya. Dhal jane wali cheezein unka Rabb nahi thin.
pages.english: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam’s argument drew attention to the setting star, moon and sun. He turned toward the Creator of the heavens and earth.

pages.title: Buton ke bare mein sawal
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne qaum ke buton ke bare mein bhi sawal uthaye. Phir unhon ne unhein tor diya aur bade but ko chhor diya.

Logon ko apne hi aqeede par ghaur karne ka mauqa mila: jinhein woh pukarte hain, kya woh apna bhi bachao kar sakte hain? Yeh waqia qaum ko sochne ki taraf bulata hai.
pages.english: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam challenged his people’s idols and broke them except the largest, prompting them to confront their beliefs.

pages.title: Aag se hifazat
pages.roman:
Qaumi jawab daleel ko qabool karna nahi tha. Unhon ne Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ko jalane ka irada kiya.

Lekin aag bhi Allah ke hukm ke taabe thi: Allah ne use Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke liye thandi aur salamati wali hone ka hukm diya. Unke khilaf ki gayi tadbeer nakaam hui aur Allah ne unki hifazat ki.
pages.english: His people intended to burn Ibrahim Alaihis Salam. Allah commanded the fire to be cool and safe for him, and their plot failed.

pages.title: Rabb ke bare mein daleel
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ka ek aur waqia ek hukmaran ke samne haq bayan karne ka hai. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ko zindagi aur maut dene wala bataya.

Phir unhon ne suraj ke mashriq se nikalne ki daleel rakhi. Inkar karne wala is daleel ka jawab na de saka.
pages.english: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam argued with a ruler about the Lord who gives life and death, then challenged him concerning the rising sun. The disbeliever was confounded.

pages.title: Dil ka itminan
pages.roman:
Apne Rabb par iman ke saath Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne dil ke mazeed itminan ki darkhwast bhi ki. Unhon ne Allah se murdon ko zinda karne ki kaifiyat ke bare mein poocha.

Unka sawal iman ke inkar ka nahi tha; woh dil ka itminan chahte the. Allah ne unhein apni qudrat ki nishani dikhayi.
pages.english: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam asked to see how Allah gives life to the dead. He affirmed his belief and sought reassurance of the heart; Allah showed him a sign.

pages.title: Hijrat aur nek aulaad ki dua
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki kahani mein dua ka silsila bhi chalta hai. Unhon ne apne Rabb ki taraf jane ka irada zahir kiya aur nek aulaad mangi.

Allah ne unhein ek burdbar bete ki khushkhabri di. Yeh nemat unki zindagi mein ita-at ki ek badi azmaish ke zikr ke saath aati hai.
pages.english: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam declared that he was going to his Lord and prayed for a righteous child. He received glad tidings of a forbearing son.

pages.title: Hajar aur Ismail Alaihis Salam ki waadi
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam Hajar aur doodh peete Ismail Alaihis Salam ko Makkah ki waadi mein laye. Us waqt wahan na abadi thi aur na pani. Unke paas khajoor aur pani ki ek mashk chhor di gayi.

Jab Hajar ko maloom hua ke yeh Allah ka hukm hai, unhon ne Allah par bharosa kiya. Is be-aab waadi mein unke aur unke bachche ke saamne ab pani ki zaroorat thi—aur isi se Safa aur Marwa ki talaash ka waqia jurta hai.
pages.english:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam brought Hajar and the nursing Ismail Alaihis Salam to the valley of Makkah. No one lived there, and there was no water. Dates and a small waterskin were left with them.

When Hajar learned that this was Allah’s command, she trusted Him. The need for water in that valley leads into her search between Safa and Marwa.

pages.title: Safa se talaash
pages.roman:
Mashk ka pani khatam hua to Hajar pani aur madad ki talaash mein niklin. Qareeb ke paharon mein Safa par charhkar unhon ne waadi ki taraf dekha ke shayad koi nazar aaye.

Wahan koi nazar nahi aaya. Talaash ka yeh pehla marhala tha; Hajar ne ab waadi ke doosre kinare, Marwa ki taraf rukh kiya.
pages.english:
When the waterskin was empty, Hajar went to look for help. She climbed Safa, the nearest hill, and searched the valley for anyone she could see.

No one was visible. Her search did not end there: she descended towards the valley and continued towards Marwa.

pages.title: Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan
pages.roman:
Safa se utarkar Hajar waadi se guzrin aur Marwa par charhin. Wahan se bhi unhon ne dekha, lekin koi nazar na aaya.

Madad ki talaash mein Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan unka aana-jana saat martaba hua. Is koshish ke baad waqia us jagah ki taraf aata hai jahan Allah ne pani ata kiya.
pages.english:
Hajar descended from Safa, crossed the valley and climbed Marwa. From there too, she looked for someone, but saw no one.

She made the journey between Safa and Marwa seven times. The account then turns to the place where Allah provided water.

pages.title: Zamzam ka pani
pages.roman:
Hajar ne Zamzam ki jagah farishte ko zameen khodte dekha. Sahih riwayat mein farishte ki erhi ya par ka zikr aata hai. Wahan pani zahir hua.

Hajar ne pani ko jama karna shuru kiya aur apni mashk bhari. Jis waadi mein pani na tha, usi mein ab Zamzam mil gaya tha. Aage isi pani ke qareeb logon ki abadi ka zikr aata hai.
pages.english:
Hajar saw an angel at the place of Zamzam, digging with his heel or wing, as the authentic narration describes. Water began to flow there.

She gathered it and filled her waterskin. The valley that had held no water now had Zamzam. The next part of the account describes people settling beside it.

pages.title: Waadi mein abadkari
pages.roman:
Zamzam ke pani ke sabab waadi mein rehne ka imkan paida hua. Jurhum ke log wahan aaye aur Hajar ki ijazat se qareeb rehne lage.

Ismail Alaihis Salam unke darmiyan barhe aur unse Arabi seekhi. Be-aab waadi, jahan ek maa aur bachcha the, ab logon ki abadi ka maqam ban gayi thi.
pages.english:
The water of Zamzam made settlement possible in the valley. People of Jurhum arrived and, with Hajar’s permission, settled nearby.

Ismail Alaihis Salam grew up among them and learned Arabic from them. The once uninhabited valley had become a place where families lived.

pages.title: Khwaab aur ita-at ki azmaish
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki ita-at ki ek badi azmaish Quran qurbani ke waqie mein bayan karta hai. Unhon ne apne bete ko khwaab mein qurbani dekhne ki baat batayi.

Donon ne Allah ki ita-at ikhtiyar ki. Allah ne is azmaish ke anjaam par badi qurbani ka fidya diya. In ayaat mein bete ka naam nahi diya gaya.
pages.english: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam told his son of the sacrificial dream. Both submitted to Allah, and Allah provided a great sacrifice in ransom. These verses do not name the son.

pages.title: Ishaq Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri
pages.roman:
Quran Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke ghar ek aur khushkhabri ka zikr bhi karta hai. Farishton ne Ishaq Alaihis Salam aur uske baad Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki basharat di.

Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki biwi ne apni aur shohar ki bari umar dekhkar hairat ki. Lekin jis Rabb ka yeh faisla tha, uske liye yeh mushkil nahi tha.
pages.english: Angelic messengers announced Ishaq Alaihis Salam and, after him, Yaqub Alaihis Salam. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam’s wife was astonished in old age, but this was Allah’s decree.

pages.title: Kaaba ki bunyadein
pages.roman:
Makkah ki isi waadi se Allah ke ghar ki tameer ka azeem waqia bhi jura hai. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam aur Ismail Alaihis Salam milkar Kaaba ki bunyadein utha rahe the.

Unki mehnat ke saath dua bhi thi: apne Rabb se is amal ki qubooliyat mang rahe the. Unhon ne apne liye aur apni aulaad mein ek ummat ke liye Allah ki farmanbardari ki dua ki.
pages.english:
Another great event linked to this valley is the building of Allah’s House. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam and Ismail Alaihis Salam raised the foundations of the Kaaba together.

Their work was accompanied by supplication: they asked their Lord to accept it. They also prayed for submission to Allah for themselves and for a community among their descendants.

pages.title: Aman aur ibadat ki dua
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki dua mein shehar ka aman bhi tha aur apni aulaad ka deen bhi. Unhon ne but-parasti se hifazat, namaz qayam rakhne aur maghfirat ki darkhwast ki.

Unki kahani mein tawheed, ita-at aur dua baar-baar samne aate hain. Nematon ke darmiyan bhi unka rujoo apne Rabb hi ki taraf tha.
pages.english: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam prayed for the city’s safety, protection from idol worship, steadfast prayer and forgiveness. His story centres on worship and submission to Allah.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki kahani tawheed ki dawat, hijrat, dua aur ita-at ke waqiat ko jorti hai.
books.openingRoman: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki kahani tawheed ki dawat, hijrat, dua aur ita-at ke waqiat ko jorti hai. Qaum ke buton se Makkah ki be-aab waadi aur Kaaba ki bunyadon tak, unka rujoo apne Rabb hi ki taraf raha.
books.openingEnglish: The story of Ibrahim Alaihis Salam brings together the call to worship Allah alone, migration, prayer and obedience. Its scenes extend from his people’s idols to the valley of Makkah and the foundations of the Kaaba.

books.name: Lut Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Qaum ko naseehat
pages.roman: Lut Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko behayai aur zulm se roka. Unhon ne unki aisi bad-amali ki nishandahi ki jo Quran ne wazeh taur par bayan ki hai.
pages.english: Lut Alaihis Salam warned his people against grave indecency and wrongdoing. The Quran describes his condemnation of their conduct.

pages.title: Mehmanon ki amad
pages.roman:
Qaumi rawaiye ka ek aur manzar mehmanon ki amad par samne aaya. Farishtay Lut Alaihis Salam ke paas mehmanon ki surat mein aaye.

Lut Alaihis Salam ko apni qaum ke rawaiye ka khauf hua. Farishton ne bataya ke woh Allah ke bheje hue hain.
pages.english: Angelic messengers came to Lut Alaihis Salam as guests. Distressed by his people’s behaviour, he was reassured that the visitors were messengers from Allah.

pages.title: Raat ko nikalne ka hukm
pages.roman: Farishton ke paigham mein nikalne ki hidayat bhi thi. Lut Alaihis Salam ko apne ghar walon ko raat ke ek hisse mein le jane ka hukm mila. Unki biwi bachne walon mein shamil nahi thi.
pages.english: Lut Alaihis Salam was instructed to leave with his household during the night. His wife was not among those who would be saved.

pages.title: Nijat aur basti ka anjaam
pages.roman:
Yeh rawangi nijat ka sabab bani. Allah ne Lut Alaihis Salam aur unke iman wale ghar walon ko bachaya.

Basti par azab aaya. Quran is waqia ko baad mein guzarne walon ke liye nishani batata hai.
pages.english: Allah saved Lut Alaihis Salam and his believing household. Punishment overtook the town, leaving a sign for those who would pass by.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Lut Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko bad-amali se roka.
books.openingRoman: Lut Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko bad-amali se roka. Mehmanon ki amad aur raat ki rawangi ke waqiat ke saath yeh kahani Allah ki hifazat aur zulm ke anjaam ko bayan karti hai.
books.openingEnglish: Lut Alaihis Salam warned his people against wrongdoing. The arrival of visitors and the departure by night lead into an account of Allah’s protection and the consequences of oppression.

books.name: Ismail Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki dua aur bete ki nemat ka zikr Quran mein hai. Ismail Alaihis Salam ki shuruati zindagi Makkah mein Sahih Bukhari ki riwayat se bayan hoti hai.

pages.title: Dua aur aulaad ki nemat
pages.roman: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne nek aulaad ki dua ki. Quran mein unhon ne barhape mein Ismail Alaihis Salam aur Ishaq Alaihis Salam milne par Allah ka shukr ada kiya.
pages.english: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam prayed for righteous offspring and thanked Allah for granting Ismail Alaihis Salam and Ishaq Alaihis Salam in old age.

pages.title: Makkah mein bachpan
pages.roman: Ismail Alaihis Salam ke bachpan ka ek aham waqia Makkah ki waadi se jura hai. Ismail Alaihis Salam doodh peete bachche the jab Ibrahim Alaihis Salam unhein unki walida ke saath Makkah laye. Us waqt wahan na abadi thi aur na pani.
pages.english: Ismail Alaihis Salam was a nursing infant when Ibrahim Alaihis Salam brought him and his mother to Makkah, then an uninhabited place without water.

pages.title: Hajar ki talaash aur Zamzam
pages.roman: Isi be-aab waadi mein pani ki zaroorat pesh aayi. Pani khatam hua to Ismail Alaihis Salam ki walida Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan madad ki talaash mein gayin. Allah ne Zamzam ka pani ata kiya.
pages.english: When their water ran out, Ismail Alaihis Salam’s mother searched between Safa and Marwa. Allah provided water at Zamzam.

pages.title: Abadi aur jawani
pages.roman:
Zamzam ke baad waadi mein abadi ka silsila hua. Jurhum ke log pani ke qareeb abad hue.

Ismail Alaihis Salam unke darmiyan barhe, Arabi seekhi aur bade hokar unmein shadi ki. Riwayat inki zindagi ka yeh hissa bayan karti hai.
pages.english: People of Jurhum settled near the water. Ismail Alaihis Salam grew up among them, learned Arabic and later married into their community.

pages.title: Walid ke saath ghar ki tameer
pages.roman: Ismail Alaihis Salam ki kahani aage ek azeem ibadat ke ghar se jurti hai. Ismail Alaihis Salam ne Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke saath Allah ke ghar ki bunyadein uthayin. Donon apne Rabb se qubooliyat aur farmanbardari ki dua karte rahe.
pages.english: Ismail Alaihis Salam helped Ibrahim Alaihis Salam raise the foundations of the House. Together they prayed for acceptance and submission to Allah.

pages.title: Sachcha wada aur namaz
pages.roman: Quran unki shakhsiyat ki pehchan bhi karata hai. Quran Ismail Alaihis Salam ko wade ka sachcha, rasool aur Nabi kehta hai. Woh apne ghar walon ko namaz aur zakat ka hukm dete the aur apne Rabb ke nazdeek pasandeeda the.
pages.english: The Quran calls Ismail Alaihis Salam true to his promise, a messenger and prophet. He instructed his family in prayer and charity and was pleasing to his Lord.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran recalls Ibrahim Alaihis Salam’s prayer and the gift of children. Sahih Bukhari relates Ismail Alaihis Salam’s infancy in Makkah.
books.teaser: Ismail Alaihis Salam ki shuruati zindagi Makkah ki be-aab waadi se jurti hai.
books.openingRoman: Ismail Alaihis Salam ki shuruati zindagi Makkah ki be-aab waadi se jurti hai. Zamzam ke pani, waadi ki abadi aur apne walid ke saath Kaaba ki tameer ke waqiat mein Allah ki nemat aur bandon ki ita-at samne aati hai.
books.openingEnglish: The early life of Ismail Alaihis Salam is linked to the valley of Makkah. Zamzam, the settlement of the valley and the raising of the Kaaba’s foundations connect Allah’s gifts with obedience.

books.name: Ishaq Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Ishaq Alaihis Salam ki paidaish ki khushkhabri Quran mein bayan hai; exact tareekh aur bachpan ki mazeed tafseel nahi di gayi.

pages.title: Barhape mein khushkhabri
pages.roman: Allah ke farishton ne Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki biwi ko Ishaq Alaihis Salam, aur uske baad Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri di. Unhon ne apni aur shohar ki bari umar dekhkar hairat ki.
pages.english: Allah’s messengers announced Ishaq Alaihis Salam and, after him, Yaqub Alaihis Salam. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam’s wife expressed astonishment at becoming a mother in old age.

pages.title: Nabuwat aur barkat
pages.roman: Yeh basharat nabuwat aur barkat ke zikr ke saath bhi aati hai. Allah ne Ishaq Alaihis Salam ko saliheen mein se Nabi banne ki khushkhabri di aur Ibrahim Alaihis Salam aur Ishaq Alaihis Salam par barkat nazil ki.
pages.english: Allah announced Ishaq Alaihis Salam as a prophet among the righteous and bestowed blessing upon Ibrahim Alaihis Salam and Ishaq Alaihis Salam.

pages.title: Neki aur ibadat ki rehnumai
pages.roman: Is nemat ke saath rehnumai ki zimmedari bhi thi. Ishaq Alaihis Salam aur Yaqub Alaihis Salam ko Allah ne nek banaya aur rehnuma banaya. Unhein nek kaam, namaz qayam karne aur zakat dene ki wahi ki gayi.
pages.english: Allah made Ishaq Alaihis Salam and Yaqub Alaihis Salam righteous leaders, inspiring good deeds, prayer and charity. They worshipped Him.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran announces Ishaq Alaihis Salam’s birth, but does not provide a precise date or detailed childhood here.
books.teaser: Barhape mein ek bete ki khushkhabri—aur uske saath Allah ki qudrat ka izhar.
books.openingRoman: Barhape mein ek bete ki khushkhabri—aur uske saath Allah ki qudrat ka izhar. Quran Ishaq Alaihis Salam ko nabuwat, neki aur barkat ke zikr ke saath yaad karta hai.
books.openingEnglish: The good news of a son in old age displayed Allah’s power. The Quran remembers Ishaq Alaihis Salam through prophethood, righteousness and blessing.

books.name: Yaqub Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki paidaish ki khushkhabri Ishaq Alaihis Salam ke baad Quran mein aati hai. Unke bachpan ki tafseel nahi di gayi.

pages.title: Khushkhabri aur rehnumai
pages.roman: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke ghar Ishaq Alaihis Salam ke baad Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri di gayi. Allah ne Yaqub Alaihis Salam ko bhi neki aur hidayat se nawaza.
pages.english: Yaqub Alaihis Salam was announced after Ishaq Alaihis Salam in the glad tidings to Ibrahim Alaihis Salam’s household. Allah granted him righteousness and guidance.

pages.title: Yusuf Alaihis Salam ka khwaab
pages.roman: Yaqub Alaihis Salam aur unke bete Yusuf Alaihis Salam ka waqia ek khwaab se bhi jura hai. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apne walid Yaqub Alaihis Salam ko khwaab bataya. Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne samjhaya ke ise bhaiyon ke samne na bayan karein aur Allah ki ata ki basharat di.
pages.english: Yusuf Alaihis Salam told Yaqub Alaihis Salam his dream. Yaqub Alaihis Salam advised him not to relate it to his brothers and spoke of Allah’s coming favour.

pages.title: Judai aur sabr
pages.roman:
Phir judai ka gham unki zindagi mein aaya. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ke bhai ghalat khabar aur khoon laga qamees laye.

Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne sabr-e-jameel ikhtiyar kiya. Gham ke bawajood unhon ne Allah se umeed na chhori.
pages.english: Yusuf Alaihis Salam’s brothers brought a bloodstained shirt and a false account. Yaqub Alaihis Salam chose beautiful patience and continued to hope in Allah.

pages.title: Dobara mulaqat
pages.roman: Lekin judai is kahani ka aakhri manzar nahi thi. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ki qamees aane par Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki basarat lauti. Baad mein ghar wale Yusuf Alaihis Salam ke paas pahunche aur judai ke baad mulaqat hui.
pages.english: Yaqub Alaihis Salam’s sight returned when Yusuf Alaihis Salam’s shirt was brought to him. The family later reunited with Yusuf Alaihis Salam after their separation.

pages.title: Aakhri naseehat
pages.roman: Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ki aakhri naseehat bhi tawheed ki thi. Maut ke waqt Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne beton se poocha ke unke baad woh kiski ibadat karenge. Unhon ne ek Allah ki ibadat aur uski farmanbardari ka iqrar kiya.
pages.english: As death approached, Yaqub Alaihis Salam asked his sons whom they would worship after him. They affirmed worship of the one God.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran announces Yaqub Alaihis Salam after Ishaq Alaihis Salam. It does not provide a detailed childhood account here.
books.teaser: Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki kahani ek walid ki naseehat, judai ke sabr aur Allah se umeed ki kahani hai.
books.openingRoman: Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki kahani ek walid ki naseehat, judai ke sabr aur Allah se umeed ki kahani hai. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ka khwaab aur baad ki mulaqat is safar ke aham manzar hain.
books.openingEnglish: The story of Yaqub Alaihis Salam includes a father’s counsel, patience through separation and hope in Allah. The dream of Yusuf Alaihis Salam and their later reunion are important scenes in that account.

books.name: Yusuf Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Bachpan ka khwaab
pages.roman:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam ki kahani ek khwaab se shuru hoti hai. Unhon ne gyarah sitaron, suraj aur chand ko apne samne sajda karte dekha aur apne walid ko bataya.

Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne unhein yeh khwaab bhaiyon ke samne bayan na karne ki naseehat ki. Is khwaab ki tabeer kahani ke aakhri hisse mein samne aati hai.
pages.english: Young Yusuf Alaihis Salam told his father of a dream in which eleven stars, the sun and moon bowed to him. His father advised discretion.

pages.title: Bhaiyon ki tadbeer
pages.roman:
Bhaiyon ke dil mein Yusuf Alaihis Salam ke liye hasad tha. Unhon ne walid se Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko apne saath le jane ki ijazat li.

Lekin saath le jane ke baad unhein kuen mein daal diya. Ghar se nikla hua bachcha ab apne ghar walon se juda tha.
pages.english: Yusuf Alaihis Salam’s brothers acted out of jealousy. They obtained permission to take him with them and then cast him into a well.

pages.title: Kuen se nikalna
pages.roman:
Bhai Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko kuen mein chhor gaye the. Wahan ek qafila aaya aur usne pani lane wala bheja. Usne dol dala to Yusuf Alaihis Salam ka pata chala.

Kuen se nikalne ke bawajood ghar ki judai khatam nahi hui. Unhein maal-e-tijarat samjha gaya aur kam qeemat par bech diya gaya. Ab unki kahani Misr ke ek naye ghar tak pahunchti hai.
pages.english:
The brothers had left Yusuf Alaihis Salam in the well. A caravan arrived and sent its water carrier, who lowered his bucket and discovered him.

Leaving the well did not end his separation from home. He was treated as merchandise and sold for a small price. The story now moves towards a new household in Egypt.

pages.title: Misr mein nayi zindagi
pages.roman:
Misr mein jis shakhs ne Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko khareeda, us ne apni biwi ko unhein izzat se rakhne ko kaha. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ab ek naye ghar mein the.

Allah ne unhein zameen mein jagah di aur ilm ata kiya. Judai aur beche jane ke darmiyan bhi un par Allah ki ata ka silsila tha.
pages.english: An Egyptian man bought Yusuf Alaihis Salam and instructed his wife to treat him honourably. Allah established Yusuf Alaihis Salam and granted him knowledge and judgment.

pages.title: Gunah se panah
pages.roman:
Isi ghar mein Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko ek sakht azmaish pesh aayi. Ghar ki aurat ne unhein gunah ki taraf bulaya, lekin unhon ne Allah ki panah mangi.

Darwaze tak pahunchne aur qamees phatne ka waqia hua. Isi qamees ka haal unki begunahi ki daleel bana.
pages.english: The woman of the house tried to seduce Yusuf Alaihis Salam. He sought refuge in Allah, and the torn shirt became evidence supporting his innocence.

pages.title: Qaid ka intikhab
pages.roman:
Azmaish ke samne Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb se hifazat mangi. Gunah ki taraf bulaye jane ke muqable mein unhon ne qaid ko pasand kiya.

Phir unhein ek muddat ke liye qaid kar diya gaya. Unki kahani ka agla hissa ab qaidkhane mein pesh aata hai.
pages.english: Yusuf Alaihis Salam preferred imprisonment to the wrongdoing being urged upon him and prayed for protection. He was later imprisoned for a time.

pages.title: Qaid mein dawat
pages.roman:
Qaidkhane mein Yusuf Alaihis Salam ke saath do jawan bhi the. Donon ne apne khwaab bataye aur unki tabeer poochhi.

Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne jawab ke saath unhein ek Allah ki ibadat ki taraf bulaya. Unhon ne wazeh kiya ke unka ilm unke Rabb ki ata hai. Phir donon ko unke khwaabon ki tabeer batayi. Qaid mein bhi unka paigham tawheed hi tha.
pages.english:
Two young men were in prison with Yusuf Alaihis Salam. Each described a dream and asked him to explain its meaning.

Yusuf Alaihis Salam called them to worship Allah alone and made clear that his knowledge was a gift from his Lord. He then explained their dreams. Even in prison, his message remained the worship of Allah alone.

pages.title: Badshah ka khwaab
pages.roman:
Phir badshah ke khwaab ka sawal Yusuf Alaihis Salam tak pahuncha. Unhon ne saat saal kasrat se kheti, uske baad saat sakht saal aur phir farakhi ki khabar di.

Qaid mein maujood Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne aane wale saalon ke liye tadbeer bhi samjhayi. Unka ilm ek badi zaroorat ke waqt samne aaya.
pages.english: Yusuf Alaihis Salam interpreted the king’s dream: seven years of cultivation, followed by seven hard years, then a year of relief.

pages.title: Begunahi wazeh hui
pages.roman:
Riha hone ka mauqa aaya, lekin Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne pehle apne upar lage ilzam ki tehqeeq mangi. Auraton ne unki begunahi tasleem ki.

Aziz ki biwi ne bhi apni ghalati ka iqrar kiya. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ka qaid se nikalna unki begunahi wazeh hone ke saath tha.
pages.english: Before leaving prison, Yusuf Alaihis Salam requested an investigation. The women acknowledged his innocence, and the wife of the Aziz admitted her wrongdoing.

pages.title: Amanat ki zimmedari
pages.roman:
Badshah ne Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko maqam aur aitimad diya. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne zameen ke khazanon ki zimmedari mangi aur apni hifazat aur ilm ka zikr kiya.

Allah ne unhein ikhtiyar ata kiya. Qaidkhane se unki zindagi ab zimmedari ke ek naye marhale tak pahunchi.
pages.english: The king honoured Yusuf Alaihis Salam. Yusuf Alaihis Salam asked to oversee the storehouses, citing his trustworthiness and knowledge, and Allah established him in authority.

pages.title: Bhaiyon se dobara mulaqat
pages.roman:
Qahat ke dino mein ghalla lene kuch log Misr aaye—yeh Yusuf Alaihis Salam ke bhai the. Unhon ne Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko na pehchana, magar Yusuf Alaihis Salam unhein pehchan gaye.

Baad ke safar mein unka saga bhai bhi saath aaya. Bachpan ki judai se jura waqia ab dobara ghar walon ki taraf laut raha tha.
pages.english: Yusuf Alaihis Salam’s brothers came for provisions without recognizing him, though he recognized them. On a later visit, his brother also came.

pages.title: Pehchan aur maafi
pages.roman:
Aakhir Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apni pehchan zahir kar di. Bhaiyon ne apni ghalati tasleem ki.

Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne un par us din malamat na karne ki baat kahi aur Allah se maghfirat ki dua ki. Badla lene ke is mauqe par unki taraf se maafi samne aayi.
pages.english: Yusuf Alaihis Salam revealed his identity. His brothers admitted their wrongdoing, and he declined to reproach them, praying for their forgiveness.

pages.title: Ghar walon ki mulaqat
pages.roman:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apni qamees walid ke paas bheji. Phir ghar wale Misr pahunche aur judai ke baad mulaqat hui.

Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apne bachpan ke khwaab ki tabeer poori hone ko pehchana. Kuen, qaid aur lambi judai ke baad unhon ne is anjaam ko apne Rabb ki meherbani kaha.
pages.english: Yusuf Alaihis Salam sent his shirt to his father, and the family came to Egypt. He recognized the fulfilment of his childhood dream as Allah’s kindness.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Ek khwaab, ghar se judai, Misr mein azmaish aur phir mulaqat.
books.openingRoman: Ek khwaab, ghar se judai, Misr mein azmaish aur phir mulaqat. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ki kahani ke marhale ek doosre se jurte hain, aur aakhir mein bachpan ke khwaab ki tabeer samne aati hai.
books.openingEnglish: A dream, separation from home, trials in Egypt and a reunion form the connected story of Yusuf Alaihis Salam. Its later events reveal the fulfilment of his childhood dream.

books.name: Ayyub Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Takleef mein dua
pages.roman: Ayyub Alaihis Salam ko takleef pahunchi. Unhon ne apne Rabb ko pukara aur uski rahmat ka zikr kiya. Bemari ki ghair-sabit, khaufnaak tafseel yahan nahi jori gayi.
pages.english: Ayyub Alaihis Salam suffered affliction and called upon his Lord, appealing to His mercy. Unestablished graphic descriptions of illness are not added.

pages.title: Pani aur shifa
pages.roman: Dua ke is waqie mein shifa ka zikr bhi aata hai. Allah ne Ayyub Alaihis Salam ko zameen par paon marne ka hukm diya aur thanda pani nahane aur peene ke liye ata kiya.
pages.english: Allah instructed Ayyub Alaihis Salam to strike the ground with his foot and provided cool water for washing and drinking.

pages.title: Rahmat aur ghar wale
pages.roman: Allah ki rahmat mein unke ghar walon ki nemat bhi thi. Allah ne unki takleef door ki aur unhein unke ghar wale aur unke saath utne hi mazeed ata kiye. Quran ise rahmat aur ibadat karne walon ke liye yaad-dihani kehta hai.
pages.english: Allah removed Ayyub Alaihis Salam’s affliction and restored his family, with as many more, as mercy and a reminder for worshippers.

pages.title: Sabr karne wala banda
pages.roman: Quran is bande ki pehchan sabr ke saath karata hai. Allah ne Ayyub Alaihis Salam ko sabr karne wala aur behtareen banda kaha jo uski taraf rujoo karta tha. Unki kahani mein dard ke saath dua aur sabr ka zikr hai.
pages.english: Allah praised Ayyub Alaihis Salam as patient, an excellent servant who repeatedly turned to Him. His account joins suffering with prayer and perseverance.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Takleef ke waqt Ayyub Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ko pukara.
books.openingRoman: Takleef ke waqt Ayyub Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ko pukara. Quran ki mukhtasar magar gehri riwayat mein dua, shifa aur Allah ki rahmat ka zikr hai.
books.openingEnglish: In affliction, Ayyub Alaihis Salam called upon his Lord. The Quran’s concise account brings together supplication, healing and Allah’s mercy.

books.name: Shuayb Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Madyan ki taraf paigham
pages.roman: Shuayb Alaihis Salam ne Madyan ko Allah ki ibadat aur naap-tol mein insaf ki dawat di. Unhon ne logon ka haq kam karne aur zameen mein fasad se roka.
pages.english: Shuayb Alaihis Salam called Madyan to worship Allah, give full measure and weight, and refrain from cheating people and spreading corruption.

pages.title: Tijarat mein diyanat
pages.roman: Unki dawat tijarat aur rozmarrah muamlaat tak bhi thi. Unhon ne kaha ke Allah ka diya hua halal baqiya unke liye behtar hai. Maqsad sirf apni istitaat ke mutabiq islah tha, aur bharosa Allah par tha.
pages.english: He taught that what Allah left lawfully was better. He sought reform as far as he could and relied upon Allah.

pages.title: Qaum ki dhamki
pages.roman: Magar qaum ke sardaron ka jawab dhamki tha. Qaum ke takabbur wale sardaron ne Shuayb Alaihis Salam aur iman walon ko nikalne ki dhamki di. Shuayb Alaihis Salam ne Allah par tawakkul kiya aur usse faisla manga.
pages.english: Arrogant leaders threatened to expel Shuayb Alaihis Salam and the believers. He placed his trust in Allah and asked Him to judge.

pages.title: Inkar aur anjaam
pages.roman: Is inkar ka anjaam bhi Quran bayan karta hai. Qaum ne inkar jari rakha. Allah ne Shuayb Alaihis Salam aur iman walon ko apni rahmat se bachaya aur zalimon ko azab ne aa liya.
pages.english: The people continued to reject the message. Allah saved Shuayb Alaihis Salam and the believers through His mercy, while punishment overtook the wrongdoers.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Shuayb Alaihis Salam ki dawat ibadat ke saath logon ke huqooq se bhi juri thi.
books.openingRoman: Shuayb Alaihis Salam ki dawat ibadat ke saath logon ke huqooq se bhi juri thi. Madyan ke logon ko naap-tol poora karne aur zameen mein fasad se bachne ki naseehat ki gayi.
books.openingEnglish: The call of Shuayb Alaihis Salam concerned worship and people’s rights. The people of Madyan were told to give full measure and weight and avoid corruption.

books.name: Musa Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Musa Alaihis Salam ki paidaish aur bachpan ka waqia Quran mein bayan hai. Exact tareekh is account mein nahi di gayi.

pages.title: Zulm ke daur mein paidaish
pages.roman:
Musa Alaihis Salam ki kahani zulm ke daur mein shuru hoti hai. Firaun logon ko girohon mein baantkar ek giroh ke beton ko qatl karwata tha.

Isi khatre ke darmiyan Allah ne Musa Alaihis Salam ki walida ko unhein doodh pilane aur khatra ho to darya mein rakhne ki hidayat di. Unki hifazat ka waqia yahin se aage barhta hai.
pages.english: Pharaoh oppressed a group of people and killed their sons. Allah guided Musa Alaihis Salam’s mother to nurse him and, when afraid, place him in the river.

pages.title: Darya se mahal tak
pages.roman:
Sanduq mein rakhe Musa Alaihis Salam darya tak pahunche. Phir Firaun ke ghar walon ne unhein utha liya.

Firaun ki biwi ne unhein qatl na karne ko kaha. Jis daur mein bachchon ki jaan ko khatra tha, Musa Alaihis Salam Firaun ke ghar tak pahunchaye gaye.
pages.english: Musa Alaihis Salam was placed in a chest in the river and taken in by Pharaoh’s household. Pharaoh’s wife pleaded that he should not be killed.

pages.title: Walida ki god mein wapsi
pages.roman:
Udhar Musa Alaihis Salam ki behen door se unki khabar leti rahi. Allah ne Musa Alaihis Salam ko doosri doodh pilane waliyon se roka.

Phir aisa sabab bana ke woh apni walida tak wapas pahunch gaye. Allah ne unki walida ki aankh thandi ki; judai ke baad bachcha phir unki god mein tha.
pages.english: Musa Alaihis Salam’s sister watched from a distance. Allah prevented him from accepting other wet nurses and reunited him with his mother.

pages.title: Jawani aur ek ghalati
pages.roman:
Musa Alaihis Salam ko jawani mein hikmat aur ilm ata hua. Ek din shehar mein jhagra dekha to unhon ne ek shakhs ko mukka mara aur woh mar gaya.

Musa Alaihis Salam ne apni ghalati par Allah se maafi mangi. Unki zindagi ab ek aur mushkil mor par thi.
pages.english: As an adult, Musa Alaihis Salam received wisdom and knowledge. During a quarrel he struck a man who died, then sought Allah’s forgiveness.

pages.title: Madyan ki taraf safar
pages.roman:
Jab khatre ki khabar mili to Musa Alaihis Salam shehar se nikal gaye. Unhon ne Allah se zalim logon se nijat aur seedhe raste ki dua ki.

Unka safar Madyan ki taraf tha. Peechhe khatra tha aur aage ke safar mein unka rujoo apne Rabb ki taraf tha.
pages.english: Warned of danger, Musa Alaihis Salam left the city and prayed for deliverance and guidance as he travelled toward Madyan.

pages.title: Pani par madad
pages.roman:
Madyan ke pani par Musa Alaihis Salam ne do auraton ko dekha aur unki madad ki. Unke liye pani pilane ke baad woh saaye mein aa gaye.

Wahan unhon ne Allah se apni zaroorat ki dua ki. Zaroorat ke is waqt bhi unhon ne pehle doosron ka kaam kiya.
pages.english: At Madyan’s water, Musa Alaihis Salam helped two women water their flock. He then rested in the shade and prayed to Allah in need.

pages.title: Aman aur ghar ki zindagi
pages.roman:
Un auraton ke walid ne Musa Alaihis Salam ko aman ki khabar di. Yahan unki shadi aur aath ya das saal ki khidmat ka muahida hua.

Shehar se nikle Musa Alaihis Salam ko ab aman aur ghar ki zindagi mili. Quran un buzurg ka naam nahi batata.
pages.english: Their father reassured Musa Alaihis Salam. An agreement involved marriage and eight or ten years of service. The Quran does not name this elder.

pages.title: Aag ke paas nida
pages.roman:
Muddat poori hui to Musa Alaihis Salam apne ghar walon ke saath rawana hue. Raste mein aag dekhi aur uski taraf gaye.

Yahin Allah ki nida aayi aur unhein nabuwat ki zimmedari aur nishaniyan di gayin. Safar ka yeh marhala Allah ke paigham ki zimmedari ka marhala ban gaya.
pages.english: After completing the term, Musa Alaihis Salam travelled with his family. Seeing a fire, he approached and received Allah’s call and signs.

pages.title: Harun Alaihis Salam ki madad ki dua
pages.roman:
Is zimmedari ke liye Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb se madad mangi. Unhon ne seena kholne, kaam aasaan karne aur zaban ki girah kholne ki dua ki.

Apne bhai Harun Alaihis Salam ko madadgar banane ki darkhwast bhi ki. Allah ne unki yeh darkhwast qubool ki.
pages.english: Musa Alaihis Salam prayed for ease, clear speech and help from his brother Harun Alaihis Salam. Allah granted his request.

pages.title: Firaun ke samne dawat
pages.roman:
Ab Musa Alaihis Salam aur Harun Alaihis Salam ko Firaun ke paas jana tha. Hukm yeh tha ke usse narmi se baat karein.

Unhon ne Allah ki nishaniyan pesh kin aur Bani Israil ko apne saath jane dene ka mutalaba kiya. Zulm ke samne Allah ka paigham pahunchaya gaya.
pages.english: Musa Alaihis Salam and Harun Alaihis Salam were sent to address Pharaoh gently, ask him to release the Israelites and present Allah’s signs.

pages.title: Jadugaron ka iman
pages.roman:
Muqable ka waqt aaya to Musa Alaihis Salam ki nishani ne jadugaron ka banaya hua dhoka mita diya. Jadugar Allah par iman le aaye.

Firaun ne unhein dhamkiyan din, lekin woh apne iman par qaim rahe. Muqable ke is manzar mein haq ko pehchanne walon ka faisla samne aa gaya.
pages.english: At the contest, the sign given to Musa Alaihis Salam overcame the magicians’ deception. They believed and remained firm despite Pharaoh’s threats.

pages.title: Sakhti aur nishaniyan
pages.roman:
Firaun ki qaum par nishaniyan aur sakhtiyan aati rahin. Woh azab hatne par apna wada tor dete the.

Aakhir Bani Israil ko raat mein nikalne ka hukm mila. Ab qaum ko zulm se nikalne ka safar darpesh tha.
pages.english: Pharaoh’s people experienced signs and afflictions, yet broke their promises after relief. The Israelites were eventually commanded to depart by night.

pages.title: Samandar mein rasta
pages.roman:
Safar mein ek sakht manzar samne aaya: peechhe Firaun ka lashkar tha aur aage samandar. Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ki rehnumai par yaqeen zahir kiya.

Allah ke hukm se samandar phata aur rasta ban gaya. Jahan rasta nazar nahi aa raha tha, Allah ne rasta ata kiya.
pages.english: With Pharaoh’s army behind and the sea ahead, Musa Alaihis Salam trusted Allah’s guidance. At Allah’s command the sea parted and a path opened.

pages.title: Nijat aur Firaun ka anjaam
pages.roman:
Allah ne Musa Alaihis Salam aur unke saath walon ko bacha liya. Unke peechhe aane walon ko gharaq kar diya gaya.

Samandar ke waqie mein nijat aur Firaun ka anjaam dono samne aaye. Quran ise ek badi nishani ke taur par bayan karta hai.
pages.english: Allah saved Musa Alaihis Salam and those with him, while the pursuing forces drowned. The Quran describes this as a sign.

pages.title: Toor par wahi
pages.roman: Quran Musa Alaihis Salam ki zindagi mein wahi aur rehnumai ka ek aur aham marhala bayan karta hai. Woh apne Rabb ki muqarrar muddat ke liye gaye aur Harun Alaihis Salam ko qaum mein apna naib banaya. Allah ne Musa Alaihis Salam se kalam kiya aur takhtiyon mein naseehat aur ahkam ata kiye.
pages.english: Musa Alaihis Salam left Harun Alaihis Salam in charge during an appointed absence. Allah spoke to Musa Alaihis Salam and gave instruction and guidance on the tablets.

pages.title: Bachhre ki azmaish
pages.roman:
Musa Alaihis Salam ki ghair-hazri mein qaum ke kuch log bachhre ki ibadat mein par gaye. Harun Alaihis Salam ne unhein is se roka tha.

Musa Alaihis Salam wapas aaye to qaum ki is sarkashi par sakht ranj zahir kiya. Allah ki nishaniyan dekhne ke baad bhi qaum ek badi azmaish mein pari.
pages.english: During Musa Alaihis Salam’s absence, some people worshipped the calf. Harun Alaihis Salam had warned them, and Musa Alaihis Salam returned deeply distressed by their wrongdoing.

pages.title: Safar mein pani aur rizq
pages.roman:
Quran isi qaum par Allah ki nematon ka zikr bhi karta hai. Pani manga gaya to chattan se barah chashme nikle.

Har giroh ne apna pani peene ka maqam pehchan liya. Unke safar mein pani aur rizq bhi Allah ki ata the.
pages.english: Allah provided for Musa Alaihis Salam’s people. When they sought water, twelve springs emerged from the rock and each group knew its drinking place.

pages.title: Ilm ke safar ki seekh
pages.roman:
Musa Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ka ilm se jura ek aur safar Surah Al-Kahf mein aata hai. Woh Allah ke ek bande ke saath chale.

Kashti, ek ladke aur deewar ke waqiat pesh aaye, jin ki hikmat baad mein kholi gayi. Yeh safar yaad dilata hai ke insaan ka ilm mehdood hai.
pages.english: Musa Alaihis Salam journeyed with a servant of Allah to learn. The reasons behind events involving a boat, a boy and a wall were explained afterward.

pages.title: Maut aur qurb ki dua
pages.roman:
Sahih Bukhari Musa Alaihis Salam ki wafat ke waqie ka zikr karti hai. Maut ka waqt aaya to unhon ne Allah se muqaddas sarzameen ke qareeb pahunchane ki dua ki.

Riwayat unki qabr ko surkh retili pahari ke qareeb batati hai. Unki kahani mein azmaishon aur zimmedariyon ke saath apne Rabb ki taraf rujoo baar-baar nazar aata hai.
pages.english: Sahih Bukhari recounts Musa Alaihis Salam’s death and his prayer to be brought near the sacred land. The report describes his grave near a red sandy hill.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran describes Musa Alaihis Salam’s birth and early life. No exact calendar date is supplied here.
books.teaser: Musa Alaihis Salam ki kahani ek bachche ki hifazat se shuru hoti hai aur Firaun ke samne Allah ka paigham pahunchane tak barhti hai.
books.openingRoman: Musa Alaihis Salam ki kahani ek bachche ki hifazat se shuru hoti hai aur Firaun ke samne Allah ka paigham pahunchane tak barhti hai. Hijrat, samandar ka rasta aur qaum ki rehnumai is safar ke aham marhale hain.
books.openingEnglish: The story of Musa Alaihis Salam begins with the protection of a child and develops into a mission before Pharaoh. Leaving Egypt, the passage through the sea and guiding his people form major stages.

books.name: Harun Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Musa Alaihis Salam ke bhai
pages.roman: Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne bhai Harun Alaihis Salam ko madadgar banane ki dua ki. Allah ne unki darkhwast qubool ki aur Harun Alaihis Salam ko unki madad ke liye diya.
pages.english: Musa Alaihis Salam asked Allah to appoint his brother Harun Alaihis Salam as a helper. Allah granted the request.

pages.title: Narmi se paigham
pages.roman: Donon bhaiyon ki zimmedari mein dawat ka ek wazeh usool tha. Musa Alaihis Salam aur Harun Alaihis Salam ko Firaun ke paas jane aur narmi se baat karne ka hukm diya gaya. Donon ne Allah ki rasalat ka paigham pahunchaya.
pages.english: Musa Alaihis Salam and Harun Alaihis Salam were commanded to approach Pharaoh with gentle speech and deliver Allah’s message.

pages.title: Qaum mein zimmedari
pages.roman: Harun Alaihis Salam ko qaum ke darmiyan bhi zimmedari di gayi. Musa Alaihis Salam apne Rabb ki muqarrar muddat ke liye gaye to Harun Alaihis Salam ko qaum mein apni jagah rakha. Unhein islah aur fasad se bachne ki hidayat di.
pages.english: When Musa Alaihis Salam left for his appointed meeting, he placed Harun Alaihis Salam in charge, instructing him to maintain order and avoid corruption.

pages.title: Azmaish mein rokna
pages.roman: Isi zimmedari mein bachhre ki azmaish pesh aayi. Jab kuch log bachhre ki taraf mayil hue, Harun Alaihis Salam ne unhein samjhaya ke unka Rabb Rahman hai. Qaum ne Musa Alaihis Salam ki wapsi tak apna amal chhorne se inkar kiya.
pages.english: When some turned to the calf, Harun Alaihis Salam reminded them that their Lord was the Most Merciful. They refused to stop until Musa Alaihis Salam returned.

pages.title: Allah ka salam
pages.roman: Quran donon bhaiyon ko apni nematon ke saath yaad karta hai. Quran Musa Alaihis Salam aur Harun Alaihis Salam dono par Allah ki nemat, nijat aur seedhi rahnumai ka zikr karta hai. Donon par salam bheja gaya hai.
pages.english: The Quran recounts Allah’s favour, rescue and guidance for Musa Alaihis Salam and Harun Alaihis Salam, and sends peace upon them.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne bhai Harun Alaihis Salam ko madadgar banane ki dua ki.
books.openingRoman: Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne bhai Harun Alaihis Salam ko madadgar banane ki dua ki. Donon ki dawat aur qaum ke darmiyan Harun Alaihis Salam ki zimmedari is kahani ka markaz hain.
books.openingEnglish: Musa Alaihis Salam asked Allah to appoint his brother Harun Alaihis Salam as a helper. Their shared mission and the responsibility of Harun Alaihis Salam among the people are central to this account.

books.name: Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Sabr walon mein zikr
pages.roman: Quran Ismail Alaihis Salam, Idris Alaihis Salam aur Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam ko sabr karne walon mein shamil karta hai.
pages.english: The Quran names Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam with Ismail Alaihis Salam and Idris Alaihis Salam among the patient. It does not supply a detailed biography in these passages.
pages.noteRoman: In ayaat se unki paidaish, shehar ya peshe ki mazeed kahani nahi banayi gayi.

pages.title: Neki aur rahmat
pages.roman: Is sabr ke zikr ke saath neki aur rahmat ka zikr bhi hai. Allah ne unhein apni rahmat mein dakhil kiya aur nek logon mein shumar kiya. Surah Sad mein bhi Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam ka zikr achhe logon ke saath aata hai.
pages.english: He is included among the righteous admitted into Allah’s mercy, and is named among the outstanding in Surah Sad.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam ke bare mein Quran tafseeli waqiat nahi sunata.
books.openingRoman: Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam ke bare mein Quran tafseeli waqiat nahi sunata. Unka zikr sabr, neki aur Allah ki rahmat ke saath aata hai; isi sabit zikr tak yeh mukhtasar kahani mehdood hai.
books.openingEnglish: The Quran gives no detailed life narrative of Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam. This short account stays with its references to patience, righteousness and Allah’s mercy.

books.name: Dawud Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Jalut ke muqable mein
pages.roman: Talut ke lashkar aur Jalut ki fauj ka muqabla hua. Allah ke izn se Dawud Alaihis Salam ne Jalut ko qatl kiya. Allah ne Dawud Alaihis Salam ko hukumat, hikmat aur ilm ata kiya.
pages.english: In the battle between Talut’s force and Jalut’s army, Dawud Alaihis Salam killed Jalut by Allah’s permission. Allah granted him rule, wisdom and knowledge.

pages.title: Zabur ki ata
pages.roman: Dawud Alaihis Salam par Allah ki ata mein wahi bhi shamil thi. Allah ne Dawud Alaihis Salam ko Zabur ata ki. Quran unhein wahi pane wale Anbiya mein zikr karta hai.
pages.english: Allah gave Dawud Alaihis Salam the Zabur. The Quran names him among the prophets who received revelation.

pages.title: Tasbeeh aur qudrat
pages.roman: Unki tasbeeh ke saath qudrat ka ek khaas zikr aata hai. Allah ne paharon aur parindon ko Dawud Alaihis Salam ke saath tasbeeh mein musakhkhar kiya. Yeh Allah ki ata thi.
pages.english: Allah subjected mountains and birds to glorify Him with Dawud Alaihis Salam. This was a gift from Allah.

pages.title: Zirah ka hunar
pages.roman: Allah ki ata sirf hukumat tak mehdood na thi. Allah ne Dawud Alaihis Salam ko zirah banana sikhaya aur loha unke liye narm kiya. Unhein achhe amal ki hidayat di gayi.
pages.english: Allah taught Dawud Alaihis Salam the making of armour and softened iron for him, commanding righteous work.

pages.title: Insaf aur rujoo
pages.roman: Hukumat ke saath insaf ki azmaish bhi aati hai. Dawud Alaihis Salam ke paas do fareeq faisle ke liye aaye. Quran unki azmaish, maghfirat ki talab aur Allah ki taraf rujoo ka zikr karta hai; ghair-sabit ilzami kahaniyan nahi jorta.
pages.english: Two disputants came before Dawud Alaihis Salam. The Quran records his test, plea for forgiveness and return to Allah, without the unestablished scandalous tales.

pages.title: Adl ka hukm
pages.roman: Isi zimmedari ka usool Quran wazeh karta hai. Allah ne Dawud Alaihis Salam ko zameen mein khalifah banakar haq ke saath faisla karne aur khwahish ki pairwi se bachne ko kaha.
pages.english: Allah appointed Dawud Alaihis Salam as a vicegerent and commanded him to judge justly rather than follow personal desire.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Jalut ke muqable ke zikr se Dawud Alaihis Salam ki kahani hukumat, hikmat aur ibadat ki taraf barhti hai.
books.openingRoman: Jalut ke muqable ke zikr se Dawud Alaihis Salam ki kahani hukumat, hikmat aur ibadat ki taraf barhti hai. Zabur ki ata aur insaf ki zimmedari un par Allah ki nematon ka hissa thin.
books.openingEnglish: From the account of Jalut, the story of Dawud Alaihis Salam turns to kingship, wisdom and worship. The gift of the Zabur and the responsibility to judge fairly were among Allah’s favours.

books.name: Sulayman Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Dawud Alaihis Salam ke baad nemat
pages.roman: Sulayman Alaihis Salam ko Dawud Alaihis Salam ki wirasat mili. Unhon ne Allah ki ata ki hui nematon ka iqrar kiya. Quran unhein Allah ki taraf rujoo karne wala behtareen banda kehta hai.
pages.english: Sulayman Alaihis Salam inherited from Dawud Alaihis Salam and acknowledged Allah’s gifts. The Quran praises him as an excellent servant who turned to Allah.

pages.title: Samajh aur faisla
pages.roman: Is nemat mein faisla karne ki samajh bhi thi. Ek kheti ke muamle mein Dawud Alaihis Salam aur Sulayman Alaihis Salam ne faisla kiya. Allah ne Sulayman Alaihis Salam ko us muamle ki samajh di aur dono ko hikmat aur ilm diya.
pages.english: Dawud Alaihis Salam and Sulayman Alaihis Salam judged a case involving a field. Allah gave Sulayman Alaihis Salam understanding and granted both wisdom and knowledge.

pages.title: Cheentiyon ki waadi
pages.roman: Shukr ka ek manzar cheentiyon ki waadi mein samne aata hai. Sulayman Alaihis Salam ne cheenti ki baat samjhi aur apne Rabb se nematon ka shukr aur nek amal ki dua ki.
pages.english: Hearing the ant in the valley, Sulayman Alaihis Salam prayed for gratitude and righteous action.

pages.title: Saba ki khabar
pages.roman: Phir kahani Saba se aane wali khabar ki taraf murti hai. Hudhud Saba se khabar laya ke wahan ek aurat hukumat karti hai aur log suraj ko sajda karte hain. Sulayman Alaihis Salam ne unhein Allah ki farmanbardari ki taraf paigham bheja.
pages.english: The hoopoe brought news of a queen and people worshipping the sun in Saba. Sulayman Alaihis Salam sent a message calling them to submit to Allah.

pages.title: Tohfa aur paigham
pages.roman: Is paigham ke jawab mein mashwara aur tohfe ka zikr aata hai. Malika ne mashwara kiya aur tohfa bheja. Sulayman Alaihis Salam ne Allah ki ata ko unke maal se behtar bataya aur apne paigham par qaim rahe.
pages.english: The queen consulted her advisers and sent a gift. Sulayman Alaihis Salam valued Allah’s gifts above their wealth and stood by his message.

pages.title: Takht aur shukr
pages.roman: Malika ke aane se pehle uska takht Sulayman Alaihis Salam ke paas laya gaya. Sulayman Alaihis Salam ne is nemat ko shukr ya nashukri ki azmaish kaha.
pages.english: Before the queen arrived, her throne was brought. Sulayman Alaihis Salam recognized this favour as a test of gratitude.

pages.title: Malika ka iqrar
pages.roman: Phir malika ne Allah ki farmanbardari ka iqrar kiya. Malika ne nishaniyan dekhin aur Sulayman Alaihis Salam ke saath Allah, Rabb-ul-alameen ki farmanbardari ka iqrar kiya. Quran is waqia mein uska naam nahi batata.
pages.english: After witnessing the signs, the queen declared submission with Sulayman Alaihis Salam to Allah, Lord of the worlds. The Quran does not name her.

pages.title: Ikhtiyar bhi Allah ki ata
pages.roman: Quran unke ikhtiyar aur wafat se juri ek aur seekh bhi deta hai. Allah ne hawa aur kaam karne walon ko Sulayman Alaihis Salam ke liye musakhkhar kiya. Unki wafat ka waqia yeh bhi wazeh karta hai ke jinn ghaib nahi jaante.
pages.english: Allah subjected the wind and workers to Sulayman Alaihis Salam. The account of his death also makes clear that the jinn did not know the unseen.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Sulayman Alaihis Salam ko ilm aur ikhtiyar ki khaas nematein milin.
books.openingRoman: Sulayman Alaihis Salam ko ilm aur ikhtiyar ki khaas nematein milin. Cheentiyon ki waadi, Saba ka paigham aur malika ki amad ke waqiat mein woh in nematon ko shukr ki azmaish ke taur par pehchante hain.
books.openingEnglish: Sulayman Alaihis Salam received special gifts of knowledge and authority. The valley of the ants, the message to Saba and the queen’s arrival reveal his recognition of these gifts as a test of gratitude.

books.name: Ilyas Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Rasool ki dawat
pages.roman: Quran Ilyas Alaihis Salam ko rasoolon mein se batata hai. Unhon ne apni qaum se Allah ka taqwa ikhtiyar karne ko kaha.
pages.english: The Quran names Ilyas Alaihis Salam among the messengers. He called his people to be mindful of Allah.

pages.title: Baal ki ibadat se rokna
pages.roman: Unki dawat mein qaumi ibadat par wazeh sawal tha. Ilyas Alaihis Salam ne qaum ko Baal ko pukarne aur behtareen paida karne wale Allah ko chhorne par toka. Unhon ne Allah ko apna aur pehle logon ka Rabb bataya.
pages.english: Ilyas Alaihis Salam challenged the people for calling upon Baal and abandoning Allah, the best of creators and Lord of their ancestors.

pages.title: Mukhlis bandon ka rasta
pages.roman: Is dawat ke samne qaum ka rawaiya bhi bayan hua hai. Qaum ne jhutlaya, magar Allah ke mukhlis bande alag rahe. Quran Ilyas Alaihis Salam ke liye baad walon mein achha zikr aur salam bayan karta hai.
pages.english: The people rejected him, except Allah’s sincere servants. The Quran preserves honourable remembrance and peace for Ilyas Alaihis Salam.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Ilyas Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko Baal ko pukarne ke bajaye Allah ki ibadat ki taraf bulaya.
books.openingRoman: Ilyas Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko Baal ko pukarne ke bajaye Allah ki ibadat ki taraf bulaya. Quran unki dawat aur un par salam ka zikr mehfooz rakhta hai.
books.openingEnglish: Ilyas Alaihis Salam called his people to worship Allah rather than invoke Baal. The Quran preserves his call and a greeting of peace upon him.

books.name: Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Hidayat pane walon mein
pages.roman: Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam ka naam Quran mein Ismail Alaihis Salam, Yunus Alaihis Salam aur Lut Alaihis Salam ke saath aata hai. Allah ne unhein fazilat ata ki. Unki zindagi ki mazeed tafseel in ayaat mein nahi milti.
pages.english: Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam is named with Ismail Alaihis Salam, Yunus Alaihis Salam and Lut Alaihis Salam among those whom Allah favoured. These verses do not provide a detailed life narrative.

pages.title: Nek logon mein zikr
pages.roman: Quran ki ek aur jagah unka zikr neki ke saath hai. Surah Sad mein Ismail Alaihis Salam, Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam aur Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam ka zikr hai aur sab ko achhe logon mein bataya gaya hai.
pages.english: Surah Sad names Ismail Alaihis Salam, Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam and Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam among the outstanding. This account stays within that established description.
pages.noteRoman: Hum isi sabit zikr tak mehdood rehte hain.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam ke tafseeli waqiat Quran mein bayan nahi hue.
books.openingRoman: Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam ke tafseeli waqiat Quran mein bayan nahi hue. Unka naam hidayat, fazilat aur neki ke zikr mein aata hai. Yahan isi pehchan ko parhein.
books.openingEnglish: The Quran does not narrate detailed events from the life of Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam. It records his name among those granted guidance, distinction and righteousness.

books.name: Yunus Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Paigham aur rawangi
pages.roman: Yunus Alaihis Salam Allah ke rasoolon mein se the. Quran unke rawana hone aur bhari hui kashti tak pahunchne ka zikr karta hai. Unki kahani ab samandar ki ek badi azmaish ki taraf barhti hai.
pages.english: Yunus Alaihis Salam was among the messengers. The Quran describes his departure and boarding a laden ship, without supplying a detailed date or itinerary.

pages.title: Samandar ki azmaish
pages.roman: Kashti mein qura dala gaya aur Yunus Alaihis Salam usmein aa gaye. Phir machhli ne unhein nigal liya. Samandar ka yeh waqia unki kahani ka woh hissa hai jahan aage unki dua ka zikr aata hai.
pages.english: Lots were drawn aboard the ship, and Yunus Alaihis Salam was among those selected. A fish swallowed him.

pages.title: Andheron mein dua
pages.roman:
Samandar ki azmaish aur machhli ke nigal lene ke baad Quran Yunus Alaihis Salam ki dua ka zikr karta hai. Andheron mein unhon ne Allah ko pukara, uski pakizgi bayan ki aur apni ghalati ka iqrar kiya.

Allah ne unki pukar qubool ki aur unhein gham se nijat di. Yeh dua usi kahani ka hissa hai jo kashti se shuru hokar aage khule kinare tak pahunchti hai.
pages.english:
After the trial at sea and the fish swallowing him, the Quran describes the supplication of Yunus Alaihis Salam. In darkness he called upon Allah, declared His perfection and acknowledged his wrongdoing.

Allah answered him and delivered him from distress. The same account that began with the ship continues towards his arrival on the open shore.

pages.title: Kinara aur hifazat
pages.roman: Yunus Alaihis Salam kamzori ki halat mein khule kinare par dale gaye. Allah ne un par beldar paudha ugaya. Sakht azmaish ke baad unki hifazat aur bahali bhi Allah ki rahmat se hui.
pages.english: Yunus Alaihis Salam was cast onto the open shore in a weakened state. Allah caused a gourd plant to grow over him.

pages.title: Qaum ka iman
pages.roman:
Yunus Alaihis Salam ki qaum ka waqia bhi umeed ka paigham rakhta hai. Woh iman le aaye to Allah ne unse ruswai ka azab hata diya.

Unhein ek muddat tak fayda uthane diya gaya. Yunus Alaihis Salam ki kahani mein dua ki qubooliyat ke saath qaum ke iman ka zikr bhi hai.
pages.english: When the people of Yunus Alaihis Salam believed, Allah removed the punishment of disgrace and allowed them enjoyment for a time.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Kashti se samandar ki azmaish tak, phir andheron mein ek dua.
books.openingRoman: Kashti se samandar ki azmaish tak, phir andheron mein ek dua. Yunus Alaihis Salam ki kahani mein apne Rabb ko pukarne aur Allah ki taraf se nijat milne ka zikr hai.
books.openingEnglish: From a ship to a trial at sea, then a supplication in darkness: the story of Yunus Alaihis Salam tells of calling upon Allah and being delivered by Him.

books.name: Zakariya Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Maryam ki kifalat
pages.roman: Zakariya Alaihis Salam ko Maryam ki dekhbhal mili. Jab woh unke paas ibadat ki jagah jate, unke paas rizq pate. Maryam ne bataya ke yeh Allah ki taraf se hai.
pages.english: Zakariya Alaihis Salam was entrusted with Maryam’s care. He found provision with her in the sanctuary, and she said it was from Allah.

pages.title: Chhupi hui dua
pages.roman:
