Maryam ke paas Allah ka ata kiya hua rizq dekhne ke waqie mein Zakariya Alaihis Salam ki dua ka bhi zikr aata hai. Unhon ne apne Rabb se nek aulaad mangi.

Surah Maryam unki chupke se ki gayi pukar bayan karti hai. Barhape aur apni biwi ke be-aulad hone ke bawajood woh Allah ki ata ke umeedwar the. Unki pukar ka jawab aage Yahya Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri mein aata hai.
pages.english:
The account of Maryam receiving provision from Allah also mentions the supplication of Zakariya Alaihis Salam for righteous offspring.

Surah Maryam describes his quiet call to his Lord. Despite his old age and his wife’s barrenness, he sought Allah’s gift. The answer appears in the good news of Yahya Alaihis Salam.

pages.title: Yahya Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri
pages.roman: Phir is dua ki khushkhabri aayi. Allah ne Yahya Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri di. Namaz ki halat mein farishton ne unhein ek nek Nabi bete ki basharat sunayi.
pages.english: Allah announced Yahya Alaihis Salam. While Zakariya Alaihis Salam stood in prayer, angels brought news of a righteous son who would be a prophet.

pages.title: Nishani aur tasbeeh
pages.roman:
Is khushkhabri par Zakariya Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb se ek nishani mangi.

Unhein kuch muddat logon se baat na kar pane ki nishani di gayi, jabke woh tandurust the. Unhon ne logon ko subah-shaam tasbeeh ka ishara kiya.
pages.english: Zakariya Alaihis Salam was given a sign: for a period he could not speak to people despite being sound. He signalled them to glorify Allah morning and evening.

pages.title: Dua ki qubooliyat
pages.roman: Quran is dua ki qubooliyat ko bhi yaad dilata hai. Allah ne Zakariya Alaihis Salam ki dua qubool karke Yahya Alaihis Salam ata kiye aur unki biwi ko durust kar diya. Quran unke nek kaamon, umeed, khauf aur khushu ka zikr karta hai.
pages.english: Allah answered Zakariya Alaihis Salam, granted Yahya Alaihis Salam and restored his wife’s ability to bear a child. The family is praised for goodness and humble devotion.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Maryam ki kifalat ke waqie ke saath Zakariya Alaihis Salam ki dua ki kahani bhi aati hai.
books.openingRoman: Maryam ki kifalat ke waqie ke saath Zakariya Alaihis Salam ki dua ki kahani bhi aati hai. Barhape mein ki gayi pukar ka jawab Yahya Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri se mila.
books.openingEnglish: Alongside his care for Maryam, the Quran tells of the supplication of Zakariya Alaihis Salam. His call in old age was answered with the good news of Yahya Alaihis Salam.

books.name: Yahya Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Yahya Alaihis Salam ki paidaish ki khushkhabri Quran mein naam ke saath di gayi. Exact tareekh aur shehar yahan muqarrar nahi kiye gaye.

pages.title: Naam ke saath basharat
pages.roman: Zakariya Alaihis Salam ko Yahya Alaihis Salam naam ke bete ki khushkhabri mili. Yeh unki dua ki qubooliyat thi aur Allah ki qudrat ki nishani.
pages.english: Zakariya Alaihis Salam was given glad tidings of a son named Yahya Alaihis Salam, an answer to his prayer and a sign of Allah’s power.

pages.title: Bachpan mein hikmat
pages.roman: Yahya Alaihis Salam ko bachpan hi mein Allah ki khaas ata mili. Yahya Alaihis Salam ko kitab mazbooti se thamne ka hukm diya gaya. Allah ne unhein bachpan mein hikmat aur apni taraf se narmi aur pakizgi ata ki.
pages.english: Yahya Alaihis Salam was commanded to hold firmly to the Scripture. Allah granted him wisdom as a child, tenderness and purity.

pages.title: Walidain ke saath neki
pages.roman: Unki pehchan mein ghar walon ke saath neki bhi thi. Quran Yahya Alaihis Salam ko parhezgar aur apne walidain ke saath nek batata hai. Woh sarkash aur nafarman nahi the.
pages.english: The Quran describes Yahya Alaihis Salam as devout and dutiful to his parents, neither arrogant nor disobedient.

pages.title: Paidaish aur anjaam par salam
pages.roman: Quran unhein salam ke saath bhi yaad karta hai. Quran Yahya Alaihis Salam ke paida hone, wafat aur dobara uthaye jane ke din salam ka zikr karta hai.
pages.english: The Quran speaks of peace upon Yahya Alaihis Salam at birth, death and resurrection. Unestablished details about how he died are not added.
pages.noteRoman: Unki wafat ki ghair-sabit tafseeli kahani yahan shamil nahi.

books.birthNoteEnglish: Yahya Alaihis Salam’s birth is announced by name in the Quran; no exact date or city is asserted here.
books.teaser: Yahya Alaihis Salam ka naam unki paidaish ki khushkhabri mein hi diya gaya.
books.openingRoman: Yahya Alaihis Salam ka naam unki paidaish ki khushkhabri mein hi diya gaya. Quran unke bachpan ki hikmat, pakizgi aur walidain ke saath neki ki pehchan karata hai.
books.openingEnglish: Yahya Alaihis Salam was named in the announcement of his birth. The Quran describes wisdom in childhood, purity and kindness to his parents.

books.name: Isa Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Isa Alaihis Salam ibn Maryam ki ghair-mamooli paidaish Quran mein tafseel se bayan hai. Exact saal ya calendar date yahan claim nahi ki gayi.

pages.title: Maryam ko khushkhabri
pages.roman: Farishton ne Maryam ko Allah ki taraf se Isa Alaihis Salam ibn Maryam ki khushkhabri di. Woh hairan huin ke unhein kisi mard ne chhua nahi; Allah jo chahta hai paida karta hai.
pages.english: Maryam received glad tidings of Isa Alaihis Salam ibn Maryam. She asked how she could have a child without a man touching her; Allah creates what He wills.

pages.title: Alag jagah aur paidaish
pages.roman:
Is basharat ke baad Quran paidaish ka waqia bayan karta hai. Maryam alag jagah gayin.

Dard-e-zah unhein khajoor ke tane tak le aaya. Unhein tasalli, pani aur khajoor ki taraf rehnumai mili.
pages.english: Maryam withdrew to a distant place. Labour brought her to a palm trunk, where she received reassurance and provision.

pages.title: God mein bachche ka paigham
pages.roman:
Maryam apne bachche ko lekar apni qaum ke paas aayin. Logon ne unse sawal kiye to unhon ne bachche ki taraf ishara kiya. Log hairan the ke god ke bachche se kaise baat karein.

Isa Alaihis Salam ne apne aap ko Allah ka banda bataya aur kitab aur nabuwat ki ata ka zikr kiya. Unki paidaish ke waqie ke saath hi unke paigham ki buniyad wazeh hoti hai: bandagi Allah ki hai.
pages.english:
Maryam brought her child to her people. When they questioned her, she pointed to him. They wondered how they could speak to a child in the cradle.

Isa Alaihis Salam declared himself Allah’s servant and spoke of the gift of scripture and prophethood. The account of his birth thus also makes clear the foundation of his message: servitude to Allah.

pages.title: Kitab aur hikmat
pages.roman: Isa Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ka paigham ilm aur rasalat se jura tha. Allah ne Isa Alaihis Salam ko kitab, hikmat, Taurat aur Injil sikhayi. Woh Bani Israil ki taraf rasool banaye gaye.
pages.english: Allah taught Isa Alaihis Salam Scripture, wisdom, the Torah and the Gospel, and sent him as a messenger to the Children of Israel.

pages.title: Allah ke izn se nishaniyan
pages.roman: Unki rasalat ke saath Allah ki nishaniyan bhi thin. Isa Alaihis Salam ko Allah ke izn se nishaniyan di gayin: bemaron ko shifa aur murdon ko zinda karna bhi unmein tha. Quran har nishani ko Allah ke izn se jorta hai.
pages.english: Isa Alaihis Salam was granted signs by Allah’s permission, including healing the sick and raising the dead. The Quran repeatedly stresses Allah’s permission.

pages.title: Ek Allah ki ibadat
pages.roman: In nishaniyon ke darmiyan dawat ek Allah hi ki taraf thi. Isa Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb aur logon ke Rabb, Allah ki ibadat ki dawat di. Unhon ne apne paigham ko seedha rasta bataya.
pages.english: Isa Alaihis Salam called people to worship Allah, his Lord and their Lord, describing this as the straight path.

pages.title: Hawariyon ki madad
pages.roman: Is dawat mein hawariyon ka jawab bhi samne aaya. Isa Alaihis Salam ne Allah ke raste mein madadgar pooche to hawariyon ne iman aur farmanbardari ka iqrar kiya. Unhon ne Allah se gawahon mein likhe jane ki dua ki.
pages.english: When Isa Alaihis Salam sought helpers in Allah’s cause, the disciples affirmed faith and submission, asking Allah to count them among the witnesses.

pages.title: Aasmani dastarkhwan ki darkhwast
pages.roman:
Hawariyon se jura ek aur waqia dastarkhwan ki darkhwast ka hai. Hawariyon ne aasman se dastarkhwan mangne ki darkhwast ki.

Isa Alaihis Salam ne Allah se rizq aur nishani ki dua ki. Allah ne utarne ke baad inkar par sakht tanbeeh ki.
pages.english: The disciples asked for a table from heaven. Isa Alaihis Salam prayed for provision and a sign, and Allah warned against disbelief after it.

pages.title: Hifazat aur Allah ki taraf uthaya jana
pages.roman: Quran Isa Alaihis Salam ke bare mein dushmanon ke dawe ki bhi tardeed karta hai. Quran ke mutabiq dushmanon ne Isa Alaihis Salam ko na qatl kiya na sooli di, balki Allah ne unhein apni taraf utha liya.
pages.english: The Quran states that his enemies neither killed nor crucified Isa Alaihis Salam; Allah raised him to Himself. No invented visual of this event is used.
pages.noteRoman: Hum is se aage man-gharat tasveer ya tafseel nahi jorte.

pages.title: Aane wale rasool ki basharat
pages.roman: Unke paigham mein aane wale rasool ki basharat bhi thi. Isa Alaihis Salam ne apne baad Ahmad naam ke rasool ki khushkhabri di. Quran unke paigham ko pehle ki Taurat ki tasdeeq aur Allah ki taraf dawat se jorta hai.
pages.english: Isa Alaihis Salam confirmed the Torah before him and announced a messenger to come after him named Ahmad.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran describes Isa Alaihis Salam’s extraordinary birth. No exact calendar date is asserted here.
books.teaser: Maryam ko di gayi khushkhabri se Isa Alaihis Salam ki ghair-mamooli paidaish ka zikr shuru hota hai.
books.openingRoman: Maryam ko di gayi khushkhabri se Isa Alaihis Salam ki ghair-mamooli paidaish ka zikr shuru hota hai. Unki rasalat aur nishaniyon ke saath Quran baar-baar Allah ke izn aur ek Allah ki ibadat ko wazeh karta hai.
books.openingEnglish: The announcement to Maryam introduces the extraordinary birth of Isa Alaihis Salam. In describing his mission and signs, the Quran repeatedly makes clear Allah’s permission and the call to worship Allah alone.

books.name: Muhammad ﷺ
books.birthNote: Is book mein exact birth date claim nahi ki gayi. Quran aapke yateem hone aur Allah ki hifazat ka zikr karta hai; sahih hadees se wahi aur zindagi ke waqiat aage aate hain.

pages.title: Paidaish ka din
pages.roman: Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Monday ke roze ke bare mein bataya ke isi din aap paida hue aur isi din wahi nazil hui. Yeh din sahih hadees se sabit hai; exact calendar date yahan claim nahi ki gayi.
pages.english: Asked about fasting on Monday, the Messenger explained that he was born on that day and revelation came on it. No exact calendar birth date is asserted here.

pages.title: Shuruati zindagi aur Allah ki hifazat
pages.roman: Ibtidai zindagi ki Allah ki nemat Quran bhi yaad dilata hai. Quran yaad dilata hai ke Allah ne aapko yateem paya aur panah di.
pages.english: The Quran recalls that Allah found you an orphan and gave shelter. This account does not invent a birth date or unestablished childhood miracles.
pages.noteRoman: Aapke bachpan ki ghair-sabit moajizati kahaniyan ya muqarrar birth date yahan shamil nahi ki gayi.

pages.title: Hira mein pehli wahi
pages.roman:
Phir zindagi ka woh marhala aaya jab wahi shuru hui. Sahih Bukhari ke mutabiq aap par wahi chalis saal ki umar mein shuru hui.

Rasool Allah ﷺ Hira mein ibadat ke liye tanhai ikhtiyar karte the. Wahi ke farishte aaye aur parhne ka hukm diya. Surah Al-Alaq ki ibtidai ayaat nazil huin.
pages.english: Sahih Bukhari places the beginning of revelation at age forty. The Messenger of Allah would withdraw to Hira for worship. The angel brought the command to recite, and the opening verses of Al-Alaq were revealed.

pages.title: Khadija ki tasalli
pages.roman: Pehli wahi ke is waqie mein Khadija ki tasalli bhi samne aati hai. Pehli wahi ke baad aap Khadija ke paas lote. Unhon ne aapke nek akhlaq, rishtedaron ki madad aur zarooratmandon ka saath dene ko yaad dilakar tasalli di.
pages.english: After the first revelation, Khadija reassured him by recalling his care for relatives, the needy, guests and those in difficulty.

pages.title: Uthkar khabardar karna
pages.roman: Wahi ke saath paigham pahunchane ki zimmedari thi. Allah ne uthkar khabardar karne, apne Rabb ki barai bayan karne aur pakizgi ki hidayat di. Rishtedaron ko bhi khabardar karne ka hukm aaya.
pages.english: Allah commanded him to arise and warn, magnify his Lord and maintain purity. He was also instructed to warn his close relatives.

pages.title: Mushkil mein sabr
pages.roman: Dawat ki mushkil mein sabr ki rehnumai bhi mili. Allah ne apne Rasool ko pichhle rasoolon ki tarah sabr ki hidayat di. Aapka kaam paigham pahunchana tha; dilon ki hidayat Allah ke ikhtiyar mein hai.
pages.english: Allah instructed His Messenger to be patient like earlier messengers. His duty was to convey the message; ultimate guidance belongs to Allah.

pages.title: Isra ka waqia
pages.roman: Quran raat ke ek khaas safar ka bhi zikr karta hai. Allah ne apne bande ko raat mein Masjid al-Haram se Masjid al-Aqsa tak safar karaya, taake apni nishaniyan dikhaye.
pages.english: Allah took His servant by night from the Sacred Mosque to the Farthest Mosque to show His signs.

pages.title: Hijrat mein ghaar ki hifazat
pages.roman: Hijrat ka waqia Allah ki madad ka ek aur manzar hai. Ghaar mein do saathiyon ke waqia ko Quran yaad dilata hai. Rasool Allah ﷺ ne saathi ko gham na karne aur Allah ke saath hone ki tasalli di.
pages.english: The Quran recalls the two companions in the cave, where the Messenger reassured his companion that Allah was with them.

pages.title: Madinah mein bhai-chara
pages.roman: Madinah mein muhajireen aur ansar ka rishta samne aaya. Quran pehle hijrat karne walon aur unki madad karne walon ki tareef karta hai. Ansar ne muhajireen se muhabbat aur apni zaroorat ke bawajood unhein tarjeeh di.
pages.english: The Quran honours the early emigrants and their helpers. The Ansar loved the emigrants and preferred them even when themselves in need.

pages.title: Badr mein madad
pages.roman: Badr ke mauqe par momineen kamzor halat mein the. Quran unhein us waqt Allah ki madad yaad dilata hai. Madad ko shukr aur taqwa ke saath jora gaya.
pages.english: The Quran recalls Allah’s help at Badr when the believers were weak, calling them to gratitude and mindfulness of Him.

pages.title: Uhud ki azmaish
pages.roman: Uhud mein ek sakht azmaish aur uski rehnumai samne aayi. Uhud ke waqia mein Quran Allah ke hukm, sabr aur itaat ki ahmiyat samjhata hai. Ghalati aur mushkil ke baad bhi Allah ki maafi aur rahmat ka zikr hai.
pages.english: The account of Uhud teaches obedience and steadfastness. Alongside mistakes and hardship, the Quran speaks of Allah’s pardon and mercy.

pages.title: Khandaq ke dino mein azmaish
pages.roman:
Ahzab ke waqt momineen ek sakht azmaish se guzre.

Allah ne hawa aur aise lashkar bheje jo nazar na aaye. Quran is nemat ko yaad dilata hai.
pages.english: During the siege by the confederates, the believers were severely tested. Allah sent wind and forces they did not see.

pages.title: Sulh aur khuli fatah
pages.roman: Surah Al-Fath ek aham marhale ki taraf tawajjuh dilati hai. Surah Al-Fath mein khuli fatah aur darakht ke neeche bayat karne walon par Allah ki raza ka zikr hai. Sabr aur aman ke muahide ka yeh aham marhala tha.
pages.english: Surah Al-Fath announces a clear victory and Allah’s pleasure with those who pledged beneath the tree, an important stage of steadfastness and peace.

pages.title: Makkah ki fatah aur tawazu
pages.roman: Fatah ke saath Quran tawazu aur istighfar sikhata hai. Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aaye aur log girohon mein deen mein dakhil hon, Quran Rabb ki tasbeeh, hamd aur maghfirat ki hidayat deta hai.
pages.english: When Allah’s help and victory come and people enter the religion in crowds, the Quran commands praise and seeking forgiveness.

pages.title: Deen ki takmeel
pages.roman: Quran mein deen mukammal karne aur nemat poori karne ka elan aaya. Sahih Bukhari batati hai ke yeh ayat Jumuah ke din Arafat mein nazil hui.
pages.english: The Quran announces the completion of religion and Allah’s favour. Sahih Bukhari reports that this verse was revealed on a Friday at Arafat.

pages.title: Rahmat aur behtareen misaal
pages.roman: In waqiat ke saath aapki rehnumai ki pehchan bhi Quran batata hai. Allah ne Muhammad ﷺ ko jahanon ke liye rahmat banaya aur momineen ke liye aapki zindagi mein behtareen misaal batayi. Aapke akhlaq ki Quran tareef karta hai.
pages.english: Allah sent Muhammad ﷺ as mercy to the worlds and made him an excellent example for believers. The Quran praises his great character.

pages.title: Wafat aur paigham ka baqi rehna
pages.roman:
Phir Rasool Allah ﷺ ki wafat ka waqt aaya. Sahih Bukhari ke mutabiq aapki wafat tirsath saal ki umar mein hui.

Rasool Allah ﷺ ki wafat ke baad Abu Bakr ne Allah ki ibadat aur Muhammad ﷺ ke Allah ke rasool hone ki yaad dilayi. Unhon ne Surah Aal-e-Imran ki ayat parhi.
pages.english: Sahih Bukhari reports his death at age sixty-three. After the Messenger’s death, Abu Bakr reminded the people to worship Allah and recited the verse affirming Muhammad ﷺ’s messengership and the mortality of messengers.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran recalls his orphanhood. This book does not assert an exact birth date; established reports of revelation and later life follow.
books.teaser: Muhammad ﷺ ki zindagi ke yeh marhale pehli wahi se dawat, hijrat aur deen ki takmeel tak pahunchte hain.
books.openingRoman: Muhammad ﷺ ki zindagi ke yeh marhale pehli wahi se dawat, hijrat aur deen ki takmeel tak pahunchte hain. Quran aur sahih hadees ki roshni mein rehmat, sabr aur Allah ki taraf bulane ka paigham parhein.
books.openingEnglish: These episodes from the life of Muhammad ﷺ extend from the first revelation to the mission, migration and completion of the religion. They present mercy, patience and the call to Allah through Quranic passages and authentic hadith.
